description.narrative:
The ¿ASEAN EU-German Climate Action Programme¿ is jointly co-financed by the European Union and the Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development and implemented by GIZ as part of the BMZ project ¿Climate Action Program¿.

The Action is part of and contributes to the EU-ASEAN Green Initiative. The action aims to contribute to components 1 ¿Horizontal Climate Change Component¿ and 5 ¿Clean, Affordable, Reliable, Sustainable and Modern Energy¿.

The Overall Objective of the Action is to improve ASEAN¿s capacity to promote regional cooperation for implementing ambitious climate policies and for accelerating the sustainable energy transition towards clean energy and greater energy efficiency.

The Specific Objectives (outcomes) of the Action are:

·        ASEAN¿s capacities to promote regional cooperation for implementing ambitious climate policies are enhanced.

·        ASEAN Member States (AMS) accelerate the transition towards renewable energy and greater energy efficiency.

description.narrative: ASEAN and its member states are better able to interlink regional and national climate policies.

NDCrelated demonstration measures linked to climate policy priorities from ASEAN strategies that consider the interests of privatesector actors have been implemented in ASEAN member states.Contributes to EUASEAN Green Initiative Output indicator 1.1.3 Ten innovative practical examples relevant to NDC implementation have been prepared and made available to ASEAN bodies, including three considering gender aspects.

comment.narrative: In progress. Demonstration measures will be conducted in 2 countries with detail progress as belowa.Indonesia for forestry sector. Supporting letter with the Ministry of Environment and Forestry under climate change directorate general regarding the implementation of the demonstration measure is estimated to be received by December 2024. Following the implementation of the measure is estimated to start in 2025.b.Vietnam for agriculture sector. Currently coordination on demonstration measures for Vietnam with the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development has been conducted. However the implementation with International Rice Research Institute expected to be conducted in end of November 2024.

comment.narrative: Side events in international fora

In 2024 some activities were conducted to prepare ASEAN for COP 29 participation such asDebriefing of the COP 28 UNFCCC outcome held in February 2024. The sessions aim to explore different synergies and interactions among climate change priorities of the ASEAN Member States. The exploration is done by assessing the relevance of global climate policies to the specific needs and challenges in the region the debriefing seeks to paint a comprehensive understanding of how ASEAN can leverage the results of global agreements to fortify its climate action and resilience efforts. In the session participants also discussed the proposal on the means of participation to increase the visibility of the ASEAN for UNFCCC 29. Thirtyeight representatives of relevant ASEAN Sectoral bodies on agriculture forestry financial integration biodiversity and energy attended the sessions.Workshop to support Lao PDR ASEAN Chairmanship conducted in February 2024. The workshop aims to draft a plan to support the development of the ASEAN Joint Statement on Climate Change to UNFCCC COP29.A consultation meeting on the ASEAN Joint Statement on Climate Change for COP 29 was conducted in July 2024. The meeting was aimed to consolidate input on the draft of the joint statement with ASEAN Working Group on Climate Change AWGCC Members and agree on the final draft. Twentythree participants from relevant representatives of the AMS attended the meeting. The ASEAN Joint Statement on Climate Change for COP 29 is available and has been endorsed by the ASOEN. In 2024 the ASEAN Negotiating group participated in one international forum on climate negotiationsCOP 29 UNFCCC will be held in November 2024. During the COP four events will be held in the ASEAN pavilions to promote showcase and explore regional priorities and collaboration.

In the session participants also discussed the proposal on the means of participation to increase the visibility of the ASEAN for UNFCCC 29. Thirtyeight representatives of relevant ASEAN Sectoral bodies on agriculture forestry financial integration biodiversity and energy attended the sessions.Workshop to support Lao PDR ASEAN Chairmanship conducted in February 2024. The workshop aims to draft a plan to support the development of the ASEAN Joint Statement on Climate Change to UNFCCC COP29.A consultation meeting on the ASEAN Joint Statement on Climate Change for COP 29 was conducted in July 2024. The meeting was aimed to consolidate input on the draft of the joint statement with ASEAN Working Group on Climate Change AWGCC Members and agree on the final draft. Twentythree participants from relevant representatives of the AMS attended the meeting. The ASEAN Joint Statement on Climate Change for COP 29 is available and has been endorsed by the ASOEN. In 2024 the ASEAN Negotiating group participated in one international forum on climate negotiationsCOP 29 UNFCCC will be held in November 2024. During the COP four events will be held in the ASEAN pavilions to promote showcase and explore regional priorities and collaboration.

comment.narrative: In progress.In 2024 2 capacity building activities were conducted as belowA knowledgesharing workshop on synergistic climate adaptation and mitigation in sectoral plans and subnational authorities was held in April 2024. This workshop was a followup implementation of the AWGCC Action Plan 20192025. The workshop aims to enhance individual and institutional capacity provide examples and guidance and foster cooperation among ASEAN Member States to integrate climate adaptation and mitigation into sectoral planning focusing on the land use sector at both national and subnational levels. Twentytwo participants of which 27 are women have participated in the training. Specifically the participants are government officials responsible for the planning of climate mitigation and adaptation in the land use sector e.g. agriculture and forestry.The second training of the Climate Negotiation training series was held in July 2024. The objective was to Strengthen AMS climate negotiators capacities and negotiation skills to advance ASEANs visibility in the climate change negotiation forum with a focus on the UNFCCC COP 29 agenda. Twentyseven participants 63 of whom were women participated in the training.In 2024 49 representatives 49 of whom are women from 8 government institutions who successfully participated in the two trainings have been added to the overall achievement to date.
